https://www.myjoyonline.com/seven-compan.body: President John Mahama has announced that seven companies have been shortlisted for the development of the Keta Port in the Volta Region. The companies were selected from 47 that submitted expressions of interest to partner with the Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority (GPHA) as strategic partners for the project. Addressing the 2026 Hogbetsotso Festival, President Mahama said the shortlisted companies have successfully completed the due diligence stage and will now proceed to the next phase of the process. He explained that the next stage would involve completing the designs and securing financing to pave the way for construction to begin. “Due diligence has been conducted, and the list has been shortlisted to seven companies. These seven companies are proceeding to the next stage, which involves completing the designs and arranging the financing for the project to commence,” he said. The President also disclosed that the administration block for the port, which was started under the previous administration, is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 2027. “Government remains committed to advancing the project on a credible foundation,” he assured. On other development projects in the Volta Region, President Mahama announced that the Sogakope-Agodome-Keta Water Project, which stalled following Ghana's debt restructuring, is expected to resume. He said the government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the contractors in October to facilitate their return to site and the completion of the first phase. On road infrastructure, President Mahama said the Ho-Denu Road is progressing steadily and is expected to be completed in 2027. He added that procurement processes are underway for the reconstruction of the road from Central University at Miotso, near Dawhenya, to Aflao. The government is also working to secure a contractor for the Dabala-Savietula-Keta-Denu Highway. President Mahama further disclosed that several roads in the Anlo area, including the Abor-Atiavi road, has been captured under the World Bank Feeder Roads Project, with procurement expected to begin soon. On healthcare, he said discussions have been initiated during his recent visit to Korea for the resumption of financing for the upgrade of the Volta Regional Hospital in Ho. He said the upgrade would ensure that the facility is befitting of a teaching hospital. The President also announced progress towards establishing a School of Pharmacy under the University of Health and Allied Sciences (UHAS), saying land had been secured and inspected by the committee overseeing its establishment. He said the next steps would involve designing the campus and proceeding to procurement. President Mahama also pledged to support other educational infrastructure requests in the region, including a new dormitory block for Anlo-Afiadenyigba Senior High School, proposed E-Blocks for Shime and Anlo Senior High Schools, and infrastructure improvements at Atiavi Senior High School and Technical School. He further acknowledged calls for the upgrading of Ohawu Agricultural College into a university. On housing, the President said an additional GH¢500 million has been allocated for district housing projects and assured the people of Anlo that the area would benefit. Unlock these with Subscription An ancient mound in Bihar's East Champaran district has been declared an archaeological site of national importance through a central government notification. The site – Ranivas Mound, at Kesariya – is spread over 1.63 acres and is under the ownership of the Bihar government, reads the gazette notification dated November 4 that was issued by the Ministry of Culture. Copies of the said notification were made available to the public on June 8, 2026 and "no objection has been received" from any person with regard to the declaration by the central government, said the notification signed by Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Director General Yadubir Singh Rawat. A copy of the notification was affixed at a conspicuous place as required under sub-section (1) of section 4 of the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act, 1958. A total of 3,686 sites around the country are under the care of the ASI, the Centre had informed Parliament in February 2026. A recommendation for listing the ancient Ranivas mound in Bihar as a centrally protected monument was sent to ASI headquarters in Delhi in 2021, a senior official told PTI in September 2022. According to the existing procedure, proposals or recommendations sent by regional ASI circles are examined by a team at the organisation’s headquarters before a final decision is taken on naming them monuments or sites of national importance. In case of meritorious proposals and recommendations, a provisional notification is first made, followed by the issuance of a final gazetted notification. A senior official said the inclusion of new sites under the ambit of the ASI is an ongoing process, based on recommendations received from various ASI “circles”, or regions, across the country from time to time. Centrally protected sites in Bihar fall under the jurisdiction of the ASI’s Patna Circle. Currently, 70 sites in Bihar are under the ambit of the ASI and governed by the Patna Circle, which is one of the oldest regional circles in India. The Patna Circle was earlier known as the Mid-Eastern Circle, and still earlier as the Buddhist Circle, ostensibly because of the important Buddhist monuments lying in the area, according to the Circle’s website. The ruins of the ancient Nalanda University in Bihar, also under the ASI, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The ancestral house of India’s first president Rajendra Prasad in Ziradei, Siwan, north Bihar, was officially declared a protected monument on May 27, 1991. Its provisional notification was done on October 30, 1990. The Shiva Temple in Gaya was notified by the ASI in 1996. Since then, no fresh site in Bihar had been brought under the ambit of the ASI, the senior official had said in September 2022. The Patna Circle earlier covered Jharkhand and a large number of sites in eastern Uttar Pradesh. While the Ranchi Circle was created in 2003 after Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar in 2000, a separate Sarnath Circle was created in 2013 for sites falling in eastern Uttar Pradesh. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/b.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受 Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinions 等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。印度比哈尔邦东昌帕兰县的一座古土丘，经中央政府发布通知，已被宣布为国家重要考古遗址。文化和旅游部于11月4日发布的官方公报通知称，该遗址位于克萨里亚的拉尼瓦斯土丘，占地1.63英亩，归比哈尔邦政府所有。通知副本于2026年6月8日向社会公开，并由印度考古局（ASI）总监察长亚杜比尔·辛格·拉瓦特签署。通知称，中央政府作出这一宣布后，“未收到任何人的异议”。根据《1958年古迹与考古遗址及遗迹法》（AMASR Act, 1958）第4条第（1）款的规定，通知副本已张贴在显著位置。2026年2月，中央政府告知议会，全国共有3,686处遗址由印度考古局负责管理。2022年9月，一名高级官员告诉印度报业托拉斯（PTI），将比哈尔邦古老的拉尼瓦斯土丘列为中央保护古迹的建议，于2021年送交位于德里的印度考古局总部。按照现行程序，各地区印度考古局分局提交的提案或建议，均由该机构总部的团队审查，之后再就是否将其命名为国家重要古迹或遗址作出最终决定。对于有价值的提案和建议，首先会发布临时通知，随后发布正式的官方公报通知。一名高级官员称，将新遗址纳入印度考古局管理范围是一项持续进行的工作，依据的是该局各分局或地区不时提交的建议。印度考古局在比哈尔邦管理的中央保护遗址，隶属该局巴特那分局管辖。目前，比哈尔邦有70处遗址纳入印度考古局的管理范围，由巴特那分局负责监管；该分局是印度历史最悠久的地区分局之一。据该分局网站称，巴特那分局此前称为中东部分局，更早时称为佛教分局，表面上是因为该地区分布着重要的佛教古迹。同样由印度考古局管理的比哈尔邦古老那烂陀大学遗址，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。印度首任总统拉金德拉·普拉萨德位于比哈尔邦北部锡万县齐拉代伊的祖居，于1991年5月27日正式宣布为受保护古迹，其临时通知于1990年10月30日发布。加亚的湿婆神庙于1996年被印度考古局列入通知名录。这名高级官员曾在2022年9月表示，自那以后，比哈尔邦没有新增遗址纳入印度考古局的管理范围。巴特那分局此前还负责贾坎德邦以及北方邦东部的大量遗址。2000年贾坎德邦从比哈尔邦分出后，兰契分局于2003年成立；2013年，又为北方邦东部境内的遗址成立了萨纳特分局。印度考古局成立于1861年，亚历山大·坎宁安担任该机构首任负责人。评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论指南。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章互动。如果你还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以查看此前在 Vuukle 上发表的旧评论。

In a statement, he raised concerns about what he described as inadequate communication from the committee overseeing the NPP-USA elections. According to Mr Boateng, members have yet to receive an election date, a published timetable or information on the register of eligible voters. “Members are not asking for miracles. They are asking for a timetable,” he said. He cited an October 29, 2026, directive by NPP General Secretary Justin Kodua requiring all outstanding elections to be completed by November 30. Mr Boateng argued that the lack of a clear roadmap was making it difficult for members to prepare and for candidates to organise their campaigns. The statement said the NPP-USA election was initially expected in July 2026 but was postponed after disagreements over an electronic voting system developed by NPP Ghana. According to Mr Boateng, members questioned the platform’s independence and raised concerns that it had not been tested in Ghana's elections. “It is important to understand that rejecting a particular voting platform does not mean rejecting democracy, technology, or the desire to elect leaders,” he said. As an alternative, he proposed voting at the various chapters, with results subsequently collated at the NPP-USA branch level. He also called for consideration of a regulated proxy voting arrangement for members unable to attend physically. He said this should include verification and accountability measures to prevent duplication, impersonation, and abuse. “The proposal is not intended to complicate the election. It is intended to build confidence,” he said. Mr Boateng also questioned how the electoral committee had been constituted. He alleged that the General Secretary established it directly, without the expected consultation with NPP-USA executives. He urged the committee to engage chapter leaders, executives, candidates and members to address concerns and build confidence in the process. His demands include publishing the voter register, allowing members to verify their eligibility and clarifying voting and results-collation procedures. He cautioned against waiting until the final days before the deadline to announce arrangements. “A credible election cannot be organised through last-minute announcements, hurried arrangements, and inadequate communication,” he said. While acknowledging the importance of meeting the deadline, Mr Boateng said speed should not come at the expense of fairness. He appealed to members to remain united despite differences over candidates and voting methods, saying the priority should be an election that strengthens the branch

Unlock these with Subscription Hundreds of students under the aegis of All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO) staged a protest at Vivekananda Circle in Dharwad on Friday, condemning the State government’s move to allow adoption of government schools by private institutions and corporate companies. Addressing the protesters, AIDSO district secretary Shashikala Meti alleged that the Congress government, which had promised to protect government schools, was pursuing policies such as the Karnataka Public Schools (KPS)-Magnet initiative and an agreement with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) that would undermine the public education system. She alleged that the government had held a meeting at Vidhana Soudha on November 4 to facilitate the handing over of government schools to private institutions and corporate companies, with 2,000 schools proposed to be taken up in the first phase. She termed the move a betrayal of the people. Ms. Meti also criticised Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and the government representatives for allegedly making derogatory remarks about government school teachers and blaming them for declining educational standards, while overlooking shortcomings in its own policies. She said the government was proposing that private institutions adopt three government schools each, with the provision to name the schools after the adopting institutions. Other proposals reportedly included deputing teachers from private schools and providing old buses, laboratory equipment and computers. The government should address deficiencies in public education and recruit adequate numbers of teachers instead of shifting its responsibility to private entities, she said. Ms. Meti alleged that 14 government schools had already been merged with the KPS at Hegganuru in Kanakapura, Bengaluru South district, contradicting the government’s assurance that no government school would be closed. She demanded the immediate withdrawal of the government’s education policies and called upon the public to join a movement against what she termed the “corporate takeover” of public education. AIDSO district president Sindhu Kou di, district organisers Shantesh Nandikollam, Siddalingappa Chippalakatti and Ravishankar Poladi, among others took part in the protest. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜国家媒体周六称，朝鲜 ruling党的一名高级官员在北京会见了中国 counterpart，这是他本周访问期间举行的一系列高级别会谈中的最新一场。朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）称，朝鲜劳动党（WPA）政治局委员兼中央委员会秘书金松男周五在钓鱼台国宾馆会见了中国共产党（CPC）中央委员会国际联络部负责人刘海星。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A senior North Korean ruling party official has met his counterpart in Beijing, the North's state media said Saturday, the latest in a series of high-level meetings during his visit this week. Kim Song-nam, a Political Bureau member and Central Committee secretary of North Korea's Workers' Party of Korea (WPA), met Liu Haixing, head of the Communist Party of China's (CPC) Central Committee's International Liaison Department, at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse on Friday, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said. It was Kim's third meeting with a senior Chinese official since he arrived Tuesday, as the two countries are seeking to deepen ties and expand cooperation after Chinese President Xi Jinping's June summit with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in Pyongyang. Kim briefed Liu on Pyongyang's "successes" in party-building work and said the whole country has been striving to meet the targets of the five-year plan adopted at the party's ninth congress in February. For his part, Liu called the visit significant for strengthening relations, according to the report. The two sides reaffirmed support for each other's policies and pledged deeper cooperation. Following the meeting, China hosted a reception for the North Korean delegation. In a separate dispatch, the KCNA said Kim also met Cai Qi, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and director of its General Office, on Friday. At the meeting, Kim reaffirmed Pyongyang's commitment to closer ties. Kim began his high-level meetings Thursday with Foreign Minister Wang Yi. His delegation arrived in Beijing as the two countries seek to shore up cooperation after relations appeared to cool amid North Korea's deepening alignment with Russia over the war in Ukraine
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜特使在中国举行第三次高级别会晤
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 据朝鲜官方媒体周六报道，朝鲜执政党一名高级官员在北京会见了中方对口官员，这是他本周访问期间一系列高层会晤中的最新一次。朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员兼中央委员会书记金松南周五在钓鱼台国宾馆会见了中共中央对外联络部部长刘海星，朝鲜中央通讯社报道称。这是金松南自周二抵达以来第三次会见中国高级官员，当时两国正寻求在今年6月中国国家主席习近平与朝鲜领导人金正恩在平壤举行峰会后深化关系并扩大合作。金松南向刘海星介绍了平壤在党建工作方面取得的“成就”，并表示全国上下都在努力实现党第九次代表大会2月通过的五年计划目标。刘海星则表示此次访问对加强两国关系具有重要意义，双方重申支持彼此的政策并承诺深化合作。会晤结束后，中方为朝鲜代表团举行了招待会。朝鲜中央通讯社在另一篇报道中称，金松南周五还与中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇举行了会晤。会晤中，金松南重申了平壤致力于加强两国关系的承诺。金松南于周四开始高层会晤，首先会见了外交部长王毅。他的代表团抵达北京之际，两国正寻求加强合作，此前因朝鲜在乌克兰战争中与俄罗斯加深结盟而使双边关系显得有所冷却。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 纽约——人工智能相关股票周五反弹，收复了前两日抛售的部分跌幅。华尔街经历数日激烈波动，试图厘清民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜将对经济产生何种影响，美国股市其余板块走势不一。标普500指数上涨0.9%，本周累计跌幅收窄至2.1%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — AI stocks are bouncing back Friday and recovering some of their sell-off from the last two days. The rest of the U.S. stock market is mixed following a whirlwind few days of Wall Street trying to sort out what this week’s sweeping victories by Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections will mean for the economy. The S&P 500 rose 0.9 percent and trimmed its loss for the week to 2.1 percent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 3 points, or less than 0.1 percent, as of 11:45 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 1.6 percent higher. Even with this week's extreme swings, the S&P 500 remains only 5.1 percent below its all-time high, which was set last month. It and other companies tied to the build-out of AI data centers tumbled this week on worries that Democratic victories in statehouses across the country could mean a slowdown in further construction, particularly in Texas. Voters across political parties say they’re wary about AI and don’t like increases to power bills caused by data centers. That built on top of worries already rattling the industry that further construction of AI data centers may slow because of how expensive it’s become to borrow money. Before that, even, critics were saying AI stock prices had shot too high and were in a bubble. But political power in Washington will still be split between a Democratic Congress and a White House run by the Republican Trump, who retains the power to veto. That could limit federal efforts to rein in the AI industry. In the meantime, companies in the industry still see strong growth. IREN, a company that delivers data centers, compute and software for AI training, reported stronger results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Its stock jumped 19.5 percent, and it also announced two new contracts signed since the end of the quarter. “We own the land, the power and the data centers under all of it, which gives us more ways to fund growth and lets us set its pace,” co-CEO Daniel Roberts said. Lam Research, a company whose equipment and services help make semiconductors, climbed 9.9 percent after announcing a program to send up to $25 billion to its investors by buying back shares of its own stock. That helped other stocks that have benefited from the build-out of AI data centers recover some of their own sharp losses. CoreWeave, which rents out access to AI chips to customers over the cloud, rose 4.5 percent. Micron Technology, which sells memory for computers, climbed 5.9 percent. Outside of AI, the U.S. stock market was mixed, and slightly more stocks fell within the S&P 500 than rose. Axon Enterprise tumbled 17.6 percent after the seller of Tasers reported weaker results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. It also announced a $1.2 billion investment in Skydio, a drone technology company. Charter Communications sank 5 percent after the internet and video provider reported a loss for the latest quarter, when analysts were expecting a profit. In the bond market, Treasury yields recovered some of their sharp drops from earlier in the week, triggered by tumbling stock prices and hopes that split control of Washington could limit how much more the U.S. government adds to its debt. The yield on the 10-year Treasury edged up to 4.85 percent from 4.84 percent late Thursday. It had topped 5.30 percent last month when worries about inflation, higher interest rates and rising government debt were spiking. Helping to support yields was a report showing U.S. employers hired many more workers last month than economists expected. It’s the latest signal that the U.S. economy continues to chug along despite high inflation. On one hand, the encouraging data could mean the U.S. economy may be able to absorb a slowdown in construction of AI data centers. But at the same time, the strong growth in jobs could push upward on inflation. Following the report, traders saw a greater probability of the Federal Reserve hiking its short-term interest rate at its next meeting in December, according to data from CME Group. Rate hikes by the Fed can rein in inflation, but they do so by making borrowing money more expensive for everyone and slowing the overall economy. A separate report, meanwhile, suggested that sentiment among U.S. consumers unexpectedly improved. The preliminary report from the University of Michigan said sentiment rose for lower- and middle-wealth Americans but fell for those with the largest stock portfolios. Perhaps more importantly for the bond market, the survey also suggested expectations for inflation in the coming year eased for Americans. That could prevent a vicious cycle where expectations for high inflation drive behavior that only worsens inflation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 人工智能概念股遭全球抛售，华尔街本周跌幅收窄
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约消息——人工智能股票周五反弹，收复了过去两天抛售的部分跌幅。在华尔街经历了一连串跌宕起伏、试图判断本周民主党在美国中期选举中取得广泛胜利将如何影响经济之后，美国股市其余板块涨跌互现。标普500指数上涨0.9%，全周跌幅收窄至2.1%。截至东部时间上午11时45分，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌3点，跌幅不足0.1%；纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.6%。尽管本周行情剧烈波动，标普500指数仍仅比上月创下的历史高点低5.1%。该指数成分股及其他与人工智能数据中心建设相关的公司本周重挫，原因包括担心民主党在全国各州议会获胜可能意味着进一步建设放缓，尤其是在得克萨斯州。各政治派别的选民表示，他们对人工智能持谨慎态度，也不喜欢数据中心推高电费。这一因素又叠加了已经令该行业不安的担忧：由于借贷成本大幅上升，人工智能数据中心的进一步建设可能放缓。此前，甚至已有批评者称人工智能股票价格涨得过高，存在泡沫。不过，华盛顿的政治权力仍将由民主党控制的国会和共和党人特朗普掌控的白宫分享，特朗普仍保留否决权。这可能限制联邦政府监管人工智能行业的努力。与此同时，该行业公司仍预计将实现强劲增长。IREN是一家提供人工智能训练所需数据中心、算力和软件的公司，其最新季度业绩好于分析师预期。该公司股价上涨19.5%，并宣布在季度结束后又签署了两份新合同。联席首席执行官丹尼尔·罗伯茨说：“我们拥有土地、电力以及贯穿其中的数据中心，这使我们有更多方式为增长提供资金，也能自行掌控增长速度。”半导体制造设备和服务企业Lam Research宣布一项计划，通过回购自身股票向投资者返还最多250亿美元后，股价上涨9.9%。这也帮助其他受益于人工智能数据中心建设的股票收复了部分大幅跌幅。CoreWeave通过云端向客户提供人工智能芯片使用服务，股价上涨4.5%。销售计算机存储芯片的美光科技上涨5.9%。人工智能板块之外，美国股市涨跌互现，标普500指数成分股中下跌股票略多于上涨股票。Taser制造商Axon Enterprise最新季度业绩不及分析师预期，股价暴跌17.6%。该公司还宣布向无人机技术企业Skydio投资12亿美元。互联网和视频服务提供商Charter Communications最新季度出现亏损，而分析师原本预计其将实现盈利，股价下跌5%。债券市场上，美国国债收益率从本周早些时候的急跌中有所回升；此前股市暴跌，加之市场希望华盛顿的分裂格局能够限制美国政府进一步增加债务，均对收益率走势产生影响。10年期美国国债收益率从周四晚间的4.84%小幅升至4.85%。上月，在通胀、利率上升和政府债务攀升的担忧推动下，该收益率一度突破5.30%。一份报告显示，美国雇主上月招聘的 workers数量远多于经济学家预期，为收益率提供支撑。这是尽管通胀高企，美国经济仍在缓慢运行的最新迹象。一方面，这一令人鼓舞的数据可能意味着美国经济能够承受人工智能数据中心建设放缓；但另一方面，就业的强劲增长可能推高通胀。报告发布后，根据CME Group的数据，交易员认为美联储在12月下一次会议上上调短期利率的可能性更大。美联储加息能够抑制通胀，但方式是提高所有人的借贷成本，并拖累整体经济。与此同时，另一份报告显示，美国消费者信心意外改善。密歇根大学的初步报告称，中低收入和中等财富美国人的信心上升，但股票投资组合规模最大的群体信心下降Perhaps对债券市场而言更重要的是，调查还显示，美国人对未来一年通胀的预期有所缓和。这可能避免形成恶性循环：高通胀预期驱动相关行为，而这些行为只会进一步加剧通胀

Unlock these with Subscription Mysuru has figured in the list of cities adjudged for the Swachh Survekshan-2025-26 awards, with the Mysuru City Corporation (MCC) receiving a formal invitation from the Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to attend the award presentation ceremony scheduled to be held in New Delhi on November 11. The invitation marks Mysuru’s inclusion in the national-level recognition for urban cleanliness and sanitation. The prestigious Swachh Survekshan-2026 awards would be presented by President Droupadi Murmu at Vigyan Bhavan in New Delhi. However, there is no official information yet on the category in which Mysuru has been selected for an award or the rank it has secured. The details will be known only after the rankings and award categories are officially announced. In 2024-25, Mysuru was ranked 3rd cleanest city in India in the 3 to 10 lakh population category under Super Swachh League (SSL), which was a newly introduced category. Mysuru was ranked the cleanest city in India for two consecutive years – 2015 and 2016. MCC Commissioner M.K. Savita and a team of officers are visiting New Delhi for the award function. Minister in-charge of Mysuru district and Urban Development Minister Yathindra Siddaramaiah and senior officials were also expected to attend the function, sources in MCC said. Expressing happiness over the invitation, Ms. Savitha credited Mysuru’s cleanliness initiatives over the years to the collective efforts of former commissioners, health officials, pourakarmikas, and engineers, who, had worked together as a team to address the shortcomings identified in earlier surveys to bring recognition to the city. The MCC Commissioner said that the 11th edition of Swachh Survekshan had commenced and expressed hope that Mysuru would secure a good position in the 2026-27 survey as well. The 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan-2025-26 was conducted under the theme ‘Swachhata Ki Nayi Pehel – Badhayein Haath, Karein Safai Saath’. Mysuru MP Yaduveer Krishnadatta Chamaraja Wadiyar expressed happiness over the MCC being invited to the Swachh Survekshan award function and congratulated pourakarmikas and citizens for their efforts. “Let us all work together to further enhance Mysuru’s reputation on the cleanliness front,” he added. “This is a proud moment for the State. Official announcement of the ranking is awaited. I congratulate the pourakarmikas, MCC officials, staff and citizens of Mysuru ahead of the award presentation,” said the Urban Development Minister, in a statement. You fumigated Rivers state so that there would be no mosquitoes. He recalled Amaechi’s role as director-general of the presidential campaigns of former President Muhammadu Buhari. Wike said the then APC candidate failed to secure up to 15 percent of the votes in Rivers state in the 2015 and 2019 presidential elections. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: Nigeria has recorded about 160 operational Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) refuelling stations across the country, with another 170 facilities at various stages of development and licensing, as the federal government intensifies efforts to expand access to cheaper alternative fuel. The Executive Chairman of the Presidential Compressed Natural Gas Initiative (PCNGI), Ismaeel Ahmed, disclosed this on Friday during the commissioning of a CNG Integrated Refuelling Unit (IRU) station along New Karu Road, Saint George Akume Way, Karu, Abuja. Mr Ahmed said the initiative had attracted approximately $2.6 billion in private-sector investments in less than two years, describing the growing investor interest as evidence that the market had moved beyond the proof-of-concept stage. “This is almost our 106th station across the country in less than two years. This is not beginning any longer. The market has been proven, and investors are trooping in,” he said. He said the additional stations were undergoing development or awaiting various approvals and licences from the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority ( NMDPRA ). According to him, President Bola Tinubu has also directed another round of infrastructure deployment, including 1,500 units in February and an additional 500 in August, which are expected to come on stream between this year and early next year. Mr Ahmed said the expansion was necessary to accelerate the adoption of CNG in a country with more than 220 million people and approximately 12 million vehicles. He argued that Nigeria needed to move faster in developing alternative fuel infrastructure to meet the country’s transportation and energy demands. “It took Nigeria about 60 years to build approximately 24,000 conventional petrol stations, most of which are privately owned. We are seeing a much faster adoption of CNG and electric vehicles, and the scale of interest is encouraging,” he said. The PCNGI chairman argued that the adoption of CNG-powered vehicles had reduced transportation fares by between 30 and 40 per cent on some routes where the buses were already operating. He cited Abuja, Lagos and Kano, as well as inter-state routes between Kano and Katsina, as locations where passengers were benefiting from lower transportation costs. According to him, passengers who previously paid between N3,000 and N4,000 on some routes now pay about N1,500 when travelling in CNG-powered buses. He said the initiative was designed to extend the benefits to all local government areas, particularly those with high concentrations of commercial vehicles and passenger traffic. However, acknowledging that the existing fleet remained insufficient to meet demand, Mr Ahmed said the government was working to deploy more buses and expand access to the alternative fuel. Asked how the government arrived at the reported 30–40 per cent reduction in transportation fares, he said the figures were based on comparisons between fares charged by operators before and after the introduction of CNG-powered buses on selected routes. He explained that the initiative obtained information from transport operators about previous fares and compared them with the fares charged after the adoption of CNG. Also speaking at the commissioning ceremony , the Permanent Secretary, State House, Temitope Fashedemi, said the facility demonstrated the federal government’s commitment to promoting CNG as a cheaper alternative to petrol following the removal of the petrol subsidy. Mr Fashedemi said President Tinubu’s administration had introduced CNG as part of efforts to cushion the impact of subsidy removal on Nigerians, particularly in the transportation and energy sectors. He said Nigeria’s abundant natural gas resources, which had historically been underutilised and flared, presented an opportunity to provide cheaper energy alternatives for households and businesses. According to him, the State House decided to demonstrate the viability of the initiative by rehabilitating an abandoned fuel depot within its premises and converting it into a CNG refuelling facility. He explained that the government partnered with the PCNGI and selected Rolling Energy Limited as the private-sector operator to rehabilitate and upgrade the facility. Mr Fashedemi said the State House provided the existing infrastructure and location, while the private-sector partner financed the rehabilitation and upgrading of the facility. “The State House did not spend public funds on the facility. We provided the infrastructure and made the location available, while the private-sector partner invested in rehabilitating and upgrading it,” he said. He added that the facility also housed a vehicle conversion centre where motorists could convert eligible vehicles to run on CNG. The permanent secretary disclosed that the State House had acquired some hybrid vehicles, while some buses operating within the Villa premises also run on alternative energy. He said some State House employees would also bring their vehicles for conversion in the coming weeks, subject to technical assessments to determine their suitability. Mr Fashedemi said the initiative was intended to demonstrate that the government was willing to lead by example rather than merely advocate the adoption of alternative fuels. He urged private investors to take advantage of the opportunities in the CNG market, noting that government support through infrastructure partnerships could accelerate the expansion of refuelling facilities. Meanwhile, the Chief Executive Officer of Rolling Energy Limited, Mubarak Danbatta, described the project as an example of the benefits of collaboration between government and private investors. Mr Danbatta commended the State House for making the abandoned facility available for redevelopment, saying the partnership demonstrated how the government could facilitate private investment by providing access to existing infrastructure. “What you are seeing here is the power of partnership. When private entities and governments come together, this is the result,” he said. He explained that the facility, known as an Integrated Refuelling Unit, combined the dispenser and compressor in a single system, with double-nozzle dispensers that allow vehicles to refuel from both sides. According to him, the station has the capacity to serve approximately 150 vehicles daily, depending on cylinder size and pressure. Its vehicle conversion centre is also projected to convert about 12 vehicles daily. The growing investment in CNG infrastructure comes as Nigeria seeks to diversify its energy mix and reduce dependence on petrol, particularly following the removal of fuel subsidies in May 2023. The Tinubu-led administration has repeatedly argued that the adoption of the CNG technology is part of the broader effort to reduce high cost of living pressures on Nigerians due to some of the ongoing reforms initiated by the government
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title_zh: 尼日利亚已有160座运营中的压缩天然气站，私人投资达到26亿美元
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 尼日利亚全国目前约有160座投入运营的压缩天然气（CNG）加气站，另有170座设施处于开发或牌照审批的不同阶段。联邦政府正加大努力，扩大民众获得这种更廉价替代燃料的渠道。总统压缩天然气倡议（PCNGI）执行主席Ismaeel Ahmed于周五在阿布贾卡鲁区Saint George Akume Way新卡鲁路沿线一座压缩天然气综合加气单元（IRU）加气站投入使用时透露了上述数据。Ahmed先生表示，不到两年时间，该倡议便吸引了约26亿美元的私人部门投资，并将投资者兴趣日益增长形容为市场已超越概念验证阶段的证据。他说：“这几乎是我们不到两年在全国建成的第106座加气站。这已经不再只是开端。市场已经得到验证，投资者正在纷至沓来。”他说，其他加气站正在开发之中，或等待尼日利亚中游及下游石油监管局（NMDPRA）的各项审批和许可。据他介绍，总统Bola Tinubu还指示开展新一轮基础设施建设，包括2月部署1,500个加气单元，8月再增加500个，预计这些设施将在今年至明年初陆续投入运营。Ahmed先生表示，在一个拥有超过2.2亿人口和约1,200万辆汽车的国家，扩大压缩天然气基础设施对于加快其普及至关重要。他认为，尼日利亚需要加快发展替代燃料基础设施，以满足国内交通和能源需求。他说：“尼日利亚花了约60年才建成约24,000座传统加油站，其中大多数为私营。我们如今看到压缩天然气和电动汽车的普及速度要快得多，关注度之广令人鼓舞。”PCNGI主席表示，在已经运营压缩天然气公交车的部分线路上，使用压缩天然气为燃料的车辆使交通票价降低了30%至40%。他列举了阿布贾、拉各斯和卡诺，以及卡诺与卡茨纳之间的州际线路，称这些地方的乘客正受益于较低的出行成本。据他介绍，此前乘客在部分线路需支付3,000至4,000奈拉，如今乘坐压缩天然气公交车只需支付约1,500奈拉。他说，该倡议旨在将相关惠益拓展至所有地方政府辖区，尤其是商用车辆和客流量高度集中的地区。不过，Ahmed先生承认现有车队仍不足以满足需求，政府正着手部署更多公交车并扩大替代燃料的可及性。当被问及政府如何得出交通票价降低30%至40%的数据时，他表示，这些数字来自对运营商在部分线路引入压缩天然气公交车前后所收取票价的比较。他解释说，该倡议向运输运营商收集以往票价信息，并将其与采用压缩天然气后收取的票价进行比较。州府常务秘书Temitope Fashedemi也出席启用仪式并表示，在取消汽油补贴后，这座设施体现了联邦政府推动压缩天然气作为汽油廉价替代燃料的承诺。Fashedemi先生说，Tinubu总统政府将压缩天然气纳入相关措施，旨在缓冲取消补贴对尼日利亚民众造成的影响，尤其是在交通和能源领域。他说，尼日利亚丰富的天然气资源过去长期未得到充分利用，部分天然气还被火炬燃烧，这为家庭和企业提供更廉价的能源替代方案创造了机会。据他介绍，州府决定通过修复其院区内一座废弃油库并将其改造为压缩天然气加气设施来展示该倡议的可行性。他解释说，政府与PCNGI合作，并选择Rolling Energy Limited担任私营部门运营商，负责修复和升级该设施。Fashedemi先生说，州府提供现有基础设施和场地，而私营部门合作伙伴出资完成设施修复与升级。他说：“州府没有为这座设施动用公共资金。我们提供了基础设施并提供了场地，而私营部门合作伙伴投资修复和升级了它。”他还补充称，该设施内还设有一座车辆改装中心，驾车者可在那里将符合条件的车辆改装为使用压缩天然气。常务秘书透露，州府已购入一些混合动力汽车，府邸内运营的部分公交车也使用替代能源。他说，未来数周，一些州府雇员也将把车辆送来改装，但须经过技术评估，以确定车辆是否适用。Fashedemi先生说，该倡议旨在表明政府愿意以身作则，而不是仅仅倡议使用替代燃料。他敦促私人投资者把握压缩天然气市场中的机遇，并指出，政府通过基础设施合作给予的支持能够加快加气设施的扩建。与此同时，Rolling Energy Limited首席执行官Mubarak Danbatta称，该项目是政府与私人投资者协作所带来惠益的实例。Danbatta先生赞扬州府提供废弃设施用于重新开发，并表示双方的合作证明，政府可以通过提供现有基础设施的使用机会来促进私人投资。他说：“你们在这里看到的是合作的力量。当私人实体与政府携手合作时，就会产生这样的成果。”他解释说，这座被称为综合加气单元的设施将加气机和压缩机整合在同一套系统中，采用双枪嘴加气机，车辆可从两侧同时加气。据他介绍，这座加气站每天可为约150辆汽车提供服务，具体取决于气瓶容量和压力。其车辆改装中心预计每天也可改装约12辆汽车。随着压缩天然气基础设施投资不断增长，尼日利亚正寻求实现能源结构多元化并降低对汽油的依赖，尤其是在2023年5月取消燃油补贴之后。Tinubu领导的政府多次表示，采用压缩天然气技术是政府推进一系列改革、减轻尼日利亚民众生活成本压力的整体努力的一部分

https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.body: Findings by LEADERSHIP Weekend across Enugu, Imo, Abia and Anambra states indicate that Peter Obi continues to enjoy considerable political influence in the South-East, particularly among young people, traders and residents dissatisfied with the country’s economic situation. However, while his supporters are optimistic that he could secure overwhelming votes across the region, some political stakeholders have cautioned that popularity alone may not translate into electoral victory, especially in the face of competing political interests, party structures and concerns about the credibility of the electoral process. In Enugu, investigations by our correspondent revealed that Obi’s influence remains considerably strong, with many residents expressing confidence in his chances of defeating other presidential contenders in the state. Interviews conducted in different parts of the state showed that several residents had already indicated their intention to vote for him in the January 2027 presidential election. His level of acceptability, it was gathered, has remained high since the 2023 general election, with his name becoming familiar across different communities and social groups in the state. A former governorship candidate in Enugu State, Prince Uche Agbo, told LEADERSHIP Weekend that Obi enjoys widespread acceptance and could defeat other presidential candidates by a wide margin. “I don’t want to mention names, but all I know is that Obi is too popular in Enugu State and pulls surprises as usual. He has a better chance of winning than other candidates,” he said. Similarly, a political scientist, Mr Ignatius Mbaeri, rated Obi’s political influence highly, arguing that his growing popularity gives him an advantage over other presidential contenders. “My brother, honestly, the fear of Obi appears to be everywhere. He pulls crowds each time he comes to Enugu, and so he has a better chance of defeating other presidential candidates,” he said. In Imo State, Obi’s political appeal has also been described as phenomenal, with supporters expressing confidence in his capacity to address the country’s economic challenges. Since his emergence as a major presidential contender in 2023, his followership in the state has reportedly continued to grow, driven largely by his promises of economic recovery, prudent management of public resources and investment in critical sectors. A political analyst, Uche Onwuchekwe, told LEADERSHIP Weekend that Nigeria needed a technocrat with the capacity to translate policy ideas into practical solutions. He identified insecurity, healthcare and infrastructure as some of the critical areas requiring urgent attention. “We have overgrown this stage of trial and error. What we need now is a man with the capability to translate words into action,” he said. Onwuchekwe argued that the prevailing economic difficulties had made Nigerians more conscious of the need to elect a president capable of transforming the country. He also suggested that some residents who support Obi might be reluctant to openly declare their political preferences for fear of victimisation. Obi’s recent visit to Imo State further demonstrated the enthusiasm among his supporters. The presidential candidate, who arrived in Owerri from Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, as part of his nationwide town hall series, visited a popular market where he interacted with traders, some of whom presented him with gifts. His subsequent town hall meeting, attended by town union leaders from the 27 local government areas, market women, students, NDC candidates and Obidient Movement organisers, attracted considerable enthusiasm. During the meeting, Obi criticised the administration of President Bola Tinubu, arguing that the South-East had not received adequate attention from the Federal Government. He also raised concerns about insecurity, poverty and the state of the economy, while promising that an NDC administration would prioritise national unity, security, healthcare, education and poverty reduction. Participants also raised concerns about the protection of their votes in 2027, to which Obi assured them that his party would work to ensure that votes counted. However, not all political stakeholders in Imo State believe his growing popularity constitutes a threat to their political interests. The Publicity Secretary of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in the state, Onwuasanya FCC Jones, dismissed suggestions that Obi posed a threat to the party, saying it had already mapped out strategies to win the election. He maintained that Imo voters would support APC candidates, including President Bola Tinubu. Similarly, an NDC stakeholder, Hon. Udubueze Uwaezuoke, said the party was determined to win the presidential election and consolidate its presence across the South-East. Meanwhile, an APGA executive, Dr George Nworji, said his party had adopted President Tinubu as its presidential candidate and would work towards delivering him in the region through grassroots mobilisation. In Abia State, findings indicate that Obi’s political influence remains strong despite his yet-to-be-reported campaign visit to the state since the flag-off of his presidential campaign activities. According to our correspondent, his supporters appear eager to receive him, with his popularity being driven largely by youths and residents dissatisfied with the prevailing economic situation. Reliable findings indicated that even some members of other political parties in the state had made up their minds to vote for Obi for president while supporting their respective parties’ candidates for other elective positions. The support, it was gathered, is influenced by ethnic considerations, political expectations, economic concerns, his persistent criticism of the Tinubu administration and his perceived commitment to transparency and prudent management of public funds. In Anambra State, however, reactions to the chances of Obi and his running mate, former Kano State Governor, Alhaji Rabiu Kwankwaso, have been mixed, although many respondents expressed confidence in the ticket. With about 72 days to the January 16, 2027 general election, political party leaders, analysts, business operators and ordinary voters who spoke to LEADERSHIP Weekend agreed that the performance of the APC-led Federal Government could work against President Tinubu’s re-election. They, however, expressed concerns that electoral manipulation, vote-buying and the influence of political structures could affect the outcome. The Senator representing Anambra Central Senatorial District, Senator Victor Umeh, expressed confidence that Obi and Kwankwaso would secure overwhelming support, predicting that the ticket could win more than 70 per cent of the votes nationwide. Similarly, the NDC Chairman in Anambra State, Hon. Ikem Uzoezie, and the State Coordinator of the party’s Presidential Campaign Council, Hon. Ifeanyi Ibezi, expressed optimism that Obi would record between 70 and 95 per cent of the votes in the state. Uzoezie recalled that Obi polled more than 500,000 votes in Anambra during the 2023 presidential election as the Labour Party candidate, expressing confidence that he could secure at least 1.5 million votes in the state in 2027. Umeh argued that Obi had demonstrated his political strength in 2023 despite lacking the political structures enjoyed by established political parties. He also said the NDC was making arrangements to protect its votes, including plans to deploy three party agents to each polling unit nationwide. A lawyer and public affairs analyst, Mr Maxwell Ezeude, also expressed optimism about Obi’s chances, citing his alliance with Kwankwaso and the prevailing economic hardship. He argued that the alliance had strengthened Obi’s political prospects by giving him access to a wider political constituency, particularly in the North. However, Ezeude warned that the influence of money in Nigerian politics, the alignment of state governors with the ruling party and possible electoral manipulation could constitute major obstacles. A community leader, Mr Tony Okafor, predicted that Obi could win overwhelmingly in the South-East and secure significant support nationally if the election was free and fair. He said many Nigerians were looking for a leader who could reduce the cost of governance and redirect public resources towards improving their welfare. The factional Chairman of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Anambra State, Comrade Patrick Obianyo, said winning the 2027 presidential election would be difficult for Obi because his political strength was now better understood by his opponents. He argued that vote-buying, financial inducements and the influence of state governors could affect the outcome. Similarly, a media consultant, Mr Titus Eleweke, acknowledged that Obi could secure considerable votes in the South-East but expressed doubts about his ability to replicate the same level of support in the North. Other respondents, however, maintained that the prevailing economic hardship could influence voters to reject the ruling party. A real estate operator, Mr Ekene Thomas, expressed confidence that young people would resist attempts to manipulate the election, while a bar attendant, Miss Uchechukwu Chukwubuike, said she would vote for Obi because of the economic difficulties confronting Nigerians. Across the four states, the findings suggest that Obi continues to enjoy considerable goodwill, with his political appeal extending beyond party membership and attracting residents who believe that the country needs a change in leadership. Nevertheless, the extent to which this enthusiasm will translate into actual votes remains a major question. While his popularity appears particularly strong in Anambra, his home state, and extends to Enugu, Imo and Abia, the positions of APGA, APC and other political stakeholders demonstrate that the South-East is not without competing political interests. The January 16, 2027 presidential election will therefore provide a clearer test of whether Obi can convert his grassroots appeal, political alliances and growing support base into electoral support across the South-East. For now, the findings point to sustained political enthusiasm around Obi in the four states covered by this investigation, although the absence of findings from Ebonyi means the assessment does not yet represent the entire South-East region. https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.title_zh: 尽管面临严峻挑战，东南部地区仍落后于Peter Obi
https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.body_zh:
LEADERSHIP Weekend在埃努古、伊莫、阿比亚和安ambara州开展的调查显示，Peter Obi在尼日利亚东南部 continues to enjoy considerable political influence，特别是在年轻人、贸易商以及不满该国经济状况的居民中。然而，尽管其支持者乐观认为他可能在整个地区获得压倒性选票，一些政治利益相关者警告说，人气本身未必能转化为选举胜利，尤其是在 competing political interests、党务组织结构以及对选举进程可信度存在担忧的情况下。

在埃努古州，本报驻记者调查显示，Obi的影响力依然相当强劲，许多居民相信他有望击败该州其他总统竞选人。在该州不同地区进行的采访显示，数名居民已表示打算在2027年1月总统选举中投票给他。采访汇总情况显示，自2023年大选以来，他的支持率一直保持高位，他的名字已为该州不同社区和社会群体所熟知。埃努古州前州长候选人Prince Uche Agbo告诉LEADERSHIP Weekend，Obi在埃努古州广受欢迎，能够以较大优势击败其他总统候选人。他说：“我不想点名，但我知道Obi在埃努古州太受欢迎了，而且他一如既往地总能带来惊喜。他获胜的机会比其他候选人都大。”

同样，政治学学者Ignatius Mbaeri先生高度评价Obi的政治影响力，认为他日益增长的人气使他相较其他总统竞选人占据优势。他说：“兄弟，坦白说，对Obi的恐惧似乎无处不在。他每次来到埃努古都能吸引大批人群，因此他击败其他总统候选人的机会更大。”

在伊莫州，Obi的政治吸引力也被形容为非同寻常，支持者相信他有能力应对该国面临的经济挑战。自2023年成为主要总统竞选人以来，据报道他在该州的追随者持续增加，这主要得益于他关于经济复苏、公共资源审慎管理和投资关键领域的承诺。政治分析师Uche Onwuchekwe告诉LEADERSHIP Weekend，尼日利亚需要一位能够将政策理念转化为切实解决方案的技术型领导人。他指出，安全局势、医疗保健和基础设施是一些亟须关注的关键领域。他说：“我们已经过度依赖这个试错阶段。现在我们需要的是一个能够把言语转化为行动的人。”Onwuchekwe认为，当前的经济困境已使尼日利亚人更加清醒地认识到，需要选出一位有能力改变国家面貌的总统。他还暗示，一些支持Obi的居民可能因为害怕遭到迫害，而不愿公开表明政治立场。

Obi最近访问伊莫州进一步显示其支持者的热情。这位总统竞选人从巴耶尔萨州叶纳戈阿抵达奥韦里，作为全国市政厅系列活动的一部分，他走访了一座热门市场并与贸易商交流，其中一些人还向他赠送了礼物。随后举行的市政厅会议有27个地方政府区域的城镇协会领袖、市场妇女、学生、NDC候选人和Obidient Movement组织者参加，现场气氛热烈。会议期间，Obi批评总统Bola Tinubu政府，认为联邦政府没有给予东南部足够关注。他还提出了对安全、贫困和经济状况的担忧，同时承诺NDC执政后将优先关注国家团结、安全、医疗保健、教育和减贫。与会者还提出关切，要求保障他们在2027年的选票得到保护，Obi向他们保证，他的党将努力确保选票得到计入。

然而，伊莫州并非所有政治利益相关者都认为他日益增长的人气对自己的政治利益构成威胁。全进步大会党（APC）州宣传秘书Onwuasanya FCC Jones否定了Obi对该党构成威胁的说法，称该党已经制定winning strategies to win the election。他坚持认为，伊莫州选民将支持APC候选人，包括总统Bola Tinubu。同样，NDC利益相关者Udubueze Uwaezuoke阁下表示，该党决心赢得总统选举，并巩固其在东南部的存在。与此同时，APGA执行委员George Nworji博士说，该党已采纳总统Tinubu作为总统候选人，并将通过基层动员在该地区推动他胜选。

在阿比亚州，调查显示，尽管Obi的总统竞选活动启动以来尚未访问该州，但他的政治影响力依然强劲。据本报驻记者称，他的支持者似乎热切期待他的到来，而他的人气主要由年轻人和不满当前经济状况的居民推动。可靠调查显示，该州甚至一些其他政党的成员也已决定在其他公职选举中支持本党候选人的同时，投票支持Obi竞选总统。据汇总情况，这种支持受到族群因素、政治期待、经济担忧、他对Tinubu政府持续不断的批评，以及外界认为他致力于透明和公共资金审慎管理等因素的影响。

然而，在安ambara州，对于Obi及其竞选搭档、前卡诺州州长Alhaji Rabiu Kwankwaso胜选前景的反应不一，尽管许多受访者对二人的组合表示有信心。距离2027年1月16日大选约72天，接受LEADERSHIP Weekend采访的各政党领袖、分析人士、商业经营者和普通选民一致认为，APC主导的联邦政府的表现可能对总统Tinubu连任不利。不过，他们也担忧选举操弄、买票和政党组织结构的影响可能左右结果。

代表安amb拉中部选区的参议员Victor Umeh参议员对Obi和Kwankwaso能否获得压倒性支持表示有信心，预测这套候选人组合可能在全国赢得超过70%的选票。同样，安ambara州NDC主席Ikem Uzoezie阁下及该党总统竞选委员会州协调员Ifeanyi Ibezi阁下乐观表示，Obi将在该州获得70%至95%的选票。Uzoezie回忆称，Obi在2023年总统选举中以工党候选人身份参选，在安amb拉获得了超过500,000票，并相信他2027年能在该州赢得至少150万票。Umeh认为，尽管缺乏成熟政党所具备的政党组织结构，Obi在2023年已经证明了其政治实力。他还说，NDC正在制定保护本党选票的措施，包括计划在全国每个投票站部署3名政党监票员。

律师兼公共事务分析师Maxwell Ezeude先生也对Obi的胜选前景表示乐观，并提到他与Kwankwaso结盟以及当前的经济困境。他认为，这一联盟让Obi得以接触更广泛的政治群体，尤其是在北部地区，从而增强了他的政治胜算。然而，Ezeude警告称，金钱在尼日利亚政治中的影响、州长与执政党的结盟以及潜在的选举操弄，都可能构成重大障碍。社区领袖Tony Okafor先生预测，如果选举自由、公平，Obi可以在东南部以压倒性优势获胜，并在全国获得大量支持。他说，许多尼日利亚人正在寻找一位能够降低治理成本、把公共资源转用于改善民生福祉的领导人。安ambara州非洲民主大会（ADC）派系主席Patrick Obianyo同志说，Obi赢得2027年总统选举并不容易，因为其政治实力如今已得到对手更充分的了解。他认为，买票、经济诱因和州长的影响都可能左右结果。同样，媒体顾问Titus Eleweke先生承认Obi可以在东南部获得相当多的选票，但怀疑他能否在北部复制同等水平的支持。

不过，其他受访者坚持认为，当前经济困境可能促使选民拒绝执政党。房地产经营者Ekene Thomas先生相信年轻人会抵制操纵选举的企图；酒吧服务员Uchechukwu Chukwubuike小姐则表示，由于尼日利亚人正面临经济困难，她将投票给Obi。

在这四个州的调查结果表明，Obi continues to enjoy considerable goodwill，其政治吸引力超出了党派成员范围，吸引了认为国家需要领导层变革的居民。然而，这份热情最终能在多大程度上转化为实际选票，仍是一个重大问题。尽管他的人气似乎在其家乡安ambara州尤为强劲，并延伸至埃努古、伊莫和阿比亚，但APGA、APC及其他政治利益相关者的立场表明，东南部并非不存在相互竞争的政治利益。因此，2027年1月16日总统选举将更清楚地检验Obi能否将其基层号召力、政治联盟和不断扩大的支持基础转化为整个东南部的选举支持。目前，调查结果显示，在本次调查覆盖的四个州，围绕Obi的政治热情持续不减；不过，由于没有获得埃博尼州的调查结果，这项评估尚不能代表整个东南部地区。

https://leadership.ng/abba-aji-clarifies.body: The retired Justice said the travel ban to the United States was still subsisting against the justices. Justice Abba Aji who spoke on the occasion of a valedictory Supreme Court session held in her honour, however, noted that the ban was part of inconveniences and a small price to pay by judicial officers to preserve the chastity of justice. Abba Aji is to formally bow out of the Supreme Court on November 7 upon attainment of the mandatory retirement age of 70 years. Recalling her experience while on the bench, she said, “My time on the Supreme Court bench was filled with challenges, some of which have served as additional opportunities to stand firm on the side of justice, regardless of the consequences. Although, Justice Abba Aji did not disclose the judgment that attracted the US travel ban on her panel members, she however said, “Such inconveniences were a price to pay to preserve the chastity of justice”. Justice Abba Aji also recalled the year 2016 while on a programme at Washington DC in the USA, she received a call that her attention was needed by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) over a petition against her in Lagos. She explained that the petition made her a regular visitor at the EFCC office answering questions on allegations of corruption she knew nothing about adding that, at the end of the investigations, she was exonerated from all the allegations. Despite the exoneration, she said the situation was chaotic and made a very difficult time for her as slanders had filled the air, adding that to worsen the situation, she could not speak in her own defense in public because of the conservative nature of the judiciary. The retiring apex court justice, charged younger generation of judges to hold fast to integrity and let justice be their compass. She counseled serving judges to serve with humility and courage and to always remember that the law is not merely a profession but a trust. Earlier, the Chief Justice of Nigeria CJN, Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun, who presided over the special court session congratulated Justice Abba Aji for diligent service to the country’s judiciary and for leaving the Supreme Court bench with unblemished record of service. The CJN said the career of Justice Abba Aji in the judiciary and the legal profession was so important to the nation and women who had followed her example on the bench. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/abba-aji-clarifies.body_zh: 已退休的大法官表示，针对法官的美国旅行禁令仍然有效。在为表彰她而举行的最高法院告别会议上发言的Abba Aji大法官指出，这项禁令虽会带来不便，却只是司法人员为维护司法廉洁所付出的微小代价。Abba Aji大法官将在达到70岁的强制退休年龄后，于11月7日正式退出最高法院。回顾自己担任法官期间的经历，她说：“我在最高法院任职期间充满了挑战，其中一些挑战也给我提供了额外机会，让我无论面对何种后果都能坚定不移地站在正义一边。”尽管Abba Aji大法官没有透露导致她及合议庭其他成员受到美国旅行禁令的具体判决，但她表示：“这种不便是为维护司法廉洁而必须付出的代价。”Abba Aji大法官还回忆说，2016年，她在美国华盛顿特区参加一个项目期间，接到经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的电话，要求她到拉各斯就针对她的申诉接受问询。她解释说，这项申诉使她经常前往经济和金融犯罪委员会办公室，回答有关她毫不知情的腐败指控；调查结束后，她洗清了所有指控。尽管最终洗清嫌疑，她表示当时的局面十分混乱，令她的日子非常艰难，因为诽谤之声四处弥漫；更糟的是，由于司法界作风保守，她无法在公开场合为自己辩护。这位即将退休的最高法院大法官告诫年轻一代法官，要坚守正直，以正义作为行动指南。她劝勉在职法官以谦逊和勇气履职，并始终牢记，法律不仅是一门职业，更是一项责任。此前，主持特别法院会议的尼日利亚首席大法官（CJN）Kudirat Kekere-Ekun大法官祝贺Abba Aji大法官为该国司法界勤勉履职，并Cleanly完成了最高法院法官任期。CJN表示，Abba Aji大法官在司法界和法律界的职业生涯，对国家以及所有以她为榜样进入法官行列的女性而言都具有重大意义。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，全天候获取最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Olakunle Olasanmi Olakunle Olasanmi是《LEADERSHIP Newspaper》的记者，拥有20多年经验，专长于司法报道。在其职业生涯中，他在报道尼日利亚及其他地区的司法体系和冲突解决方面表现卓越。通过准确、生动和独家的报道，他已成为法律事务领域值得信赖的权威。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: Humanity wins USA midterm elections, but the Trump menace remains, By Owei Lakemfa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: President Donald Trump of the United States, US still appears dazed from the severe electoral blows he received from his fellow citizens in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Trump and his fellow MAGA lost the elections for various reasons including the fact that they could not understand that inflation is biting hard in the country. Generally, the outcome of the US midterm elections, is a plus for the human race.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在2026年中期选举中遭到本国民众重创后，美国似乎仍处于惊愕之中。特朗普及其 fellow MAGA 因多种原因在选举中失利，其中包括他们未能认识到通胀正严重侵蚀该国。总体而言，美国中期选举的结果对人类有益。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Generally, the world has been made far less safe by Trump, the American voters are aware of this and, want to reclaim their country from the MAGAs. They demonstrated this by employing their votes. Ironically, many Republicans may not be unhappy with the turn of events as they also want to reclaim their party, or what is left of it, from the riotous MAGA mob. President Donald Trump of the United States, US still appears dazed from the severe electoral blows he received from his fellow citizens in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Living under messianic illusions, he cannot believe and, is yet to come to terms that the aura of indispensability he created around himself has evaporated. He first accepted the humiliating defeat which has set Democrats firmly in the leadership seats of the Congress and the Senate where his fellow Republicans lost seven seats. Then he issues threats: “Democrats will send things that are insane and I will veto them.” He may not have realized that the new Senate is not the old one that pampered and, allowed him to get away with mass murders including burying Iranian school children under the rubbles of their classrooms or, playing Al Pacino-like gangsterism across the globe. Trump and his fellow MAGA lost the elections for various reasons including the fact that they could not understand that inflation is biting hard in the country. When I was in the US in October, common complaints I heard included rising costs of grocery and fuel. The people were also tired of gangsterism in the streets by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement, ICE agents. Even as Trump and his allies talked glibly about war in Iran, the American citizenry seemed war-weary. Ironically, Trump appeared to have misread the situation. On 2 November, the eve of the elections, he said there had been no US attacks against Iran in two months and wandered whether this was actually a war. He thought the best way to bolster the low Republican ratings in the polls was to immediately attack Iran. He did that day, unaware that he was further digging his political grave. As we say in Nigeria, he was actually pouring petrol to the fire roasting the Republicans. He also might not have realized that the rising global cries against war, were reaching receptive ears in the US. He claims the rising prices of oil in the world due to his undeclared war against Iran, have benefited the US as the country makes more money from oil including the crude theft of Venezuelan oil. But his knowledge of economics is so limited that he did not realise that the war and unstable crude oil prices has led to global economic crises which are pushing the boundaries of inflation in the US itself. In other words, the resultant global economic downturn also has negative effects in the streets of the US. Also, the global tariff wars inflicted by Trump on various countries including neighbouring Canada and far away China, have also negatively affected the US and, many Americans are tired of wars whether economic, military or anti-immigrant. Trump might have had the delusion that he is a modern day American Cowboy, gunslinging and wiping out bad boys like the Iranian leadership. He did not realise that such behaviour was what was to be ashamed about not, glorified. So, with the US unable to protect its allies in the Gulf when the Iranians retaliated, traditional European countries ignoring Trump calls to rally and jointly invade Iran and, the US inability to even protect the Strait of Hormuz, US had lost face. Basically, it is losing the war against Iran and, not a few Americans are unaware. There is also the issue of Trump portraying the US as being so lawless and cowardly, that without declaring war, it invaded the bedroom of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, abducting him and his wife, Cilia Adela Flores. Today, he holds them in US detention without being able to press the so-called charges of drug running against them. Instead, all the US is doing is, shadow-boxing, holding the couple illegally, preventing elections from being held in Venezuela and stealing that country’s oil and gas. The American voters are also weary of their country being isolated globally even by traditional European allies against whom Trump threatened war in order to seize the Danish colony of Greenland. Generally, the world has been made far less safe by Trump, the American voters are aware of this and, want to reclaim their country from the MAGAs. They demonstrated this by employing their votes. Ironically, many Republicans may not be unhappy with the turn of events as they also want to reclaim their party, or what is left of it, from the riotous MAGA mob. Another issue that affected the Republicans was the choice or imposition of candidates. For instance, it had former Texas Attorney General Ken Warren Paxton as its Senatorial candidate in Texas. The challenge was that Paxton had on 28 July, 2015 been indicted by a grand jury on three criminal charges. Two of the counts were on securities fraud (a first degree felony) and the third, for failing to register with state securities regulators. This 63-year old, was a contrast with the 37-year-old Democratic candidate, James Dell Talarico, a former high school English Language teacher and advocate of increased school funding. Talarico secured 5,445,121 or 55.1 per cent of the votes and, Paxton, 4,249,752 or 43 per cent. Another case was Michael Whatley, said to be very supportive of Trump. He ran for Senate in North Carolina and got 1,643,088 votes while Democratic candidate, Roy Cooper won with 2,467,963 votes. But the Trump effect was not all round negative. The voters reaction to him might also have produced some positive results. For instance, it produced Keisha Lance Bottoms as the first Black Woman Governor in 250 years of US history and, Democrat, Deb Haaland of New Mexico as the first Native American woman Governor in US history. It also produced the first Muslim Senator, First female Native Senator and first Gen Z woman in Congress. For us in Nigeria, four Nigerian-Americans won elections in Maryland, Washington, Texas and Pennsylvania. World reaction to the changes in the US are as expected, varied. Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei does not foresee any fundamental shift in US policy towards his country. He therefore declared: “Those who still harbour even the slightest hope that the behaviour of the hegemonic system might change through partisan or factional shifts, or who imagine that making concessions to the United States can dissuade it from hostility towards the Iranian nation, are seriously mistaken.” The hope of the European Union is the continuation and prolongation of the Russo-Ukrainian War. Its Vice President Kaja Kallas said she hopes the new Congress will continue supporting Ukraine. This is in contrast to Trump’s salutary efforts to end the senseless bloodshed. Generally, the outcome of the US midterm elections, is a plus for the human race. We look forward to a safer, saner world with Trump safely out of the White House. Owei Lakemfa , a former secretary general of African workers, is a human rights activist, journalist and author

总体而言，特朗普让这个世界变得远不如过去安全，美国选民对此心知肚明，并希望从MAGA阵营手中夺回自己的国家。他们通过投票表达了这一意愿。讽刺的是，许多共和党人未必会为事态的这一变化感到不满，因为他们也想从这个躁动不安的MAGA人群手中夺回自己的政党，或夺回政党仅剩的部分。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在2026年中期选举中遭到同胞的沉重打击后，似乎仍处于恍惚状态。他一直活在救世主式的幻想中，无法相信自己尚未接受一个事实：他在自己周围营造的不可或缺感已经消散。他起初接受了这羞辱性的失败，这次失败使民主党人稳稳占据了国会和参议院的领导席位，而共和党的同胞议员则失去了7个席位。随后，他发出威胁：“民主党人会上交一些疯狂的东西，我会否决它们。”他可能没有意识到，新一届参议院已经不同于过去那个纵容他、让他得以逍遥法外的大规模谋杀得以发生，包括把伊朗学童埋在教室废墟下，或像阿尔·帕西诺式的黑帮分子一样在全世界横行。特朗普和他的MAGA同僚之所以在选举中失败，原因多种多样，其中包括他们未能理解通胀正给这个国家带来严重冲击。10月我在美国时，听到的普遍抱怨包括食品杂货和燃料价格上涨。民众也厌倦了美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）特人员在街头实施黑帮式执法。就在特朗普及其盟友轻率地谈论对伊朗开战时，美国公众似乎也已厌倦战争。讽刺的是，特朗普似乎误判了局势。11月2日，也就是选举前夕，他表示美国已有两个月没有袭击伊朗，并怀疑这实际上算不算战争。他认为，提升共和党民调支持率的最佳办法，就是立即攻击伊朗。当天他果真这么做了，却不知道这样只会进一步挖掘自己的政治坟墓。用我们尼日利亚人的话说，他实际上是在往烤焦共和党人的火上浇油。他可能还没有意识到，全球反对战争的呼声正在美国得到回应。他声称，由于他对伊朗发动了未宣战的世界油价上涨，让美国受益，因为美国通过石油赚了更多钱，这也包括盗取委内瑞拉原油。但他的经济学知识极其有限，以至于没有意识到，战争和不稳定的原油价格已引发全球经济危机，并把美国自身的通胀推向更高水平。换言之，随之而来的全球经济衰退也对美国街头的民众造成了负面影响。此外，特朗普对包括邻国加拿大和遥远的中国在内的多个国家挑起的全球关税战，也对美国造成了负面影响；许多美国人已经厌倦了各种战争，无论是经济战、军事战，还是反移民战。特朗普或许产生了错觉，以为自己是现代版美国牛仔，持枪逞强并消灭伊朗领导层之类的坏人。他没有意识到，这种行为应当令人羞耻，而不是受到颂扬。因此，在伊朗人报复时美国无力保护海湾盟友、传统欧洲国家无视特朗普集结力量共同入侵伊朗的号召、美国甚至无力保护霍尔木兹海峡的情况下，美国已经颜面尽失。归根结底，它正在输掉对伊朗的战争，而且不少美国人并未意识到这一点。另一个问题是，特朗普把美国描绘成一个如此无法无天、如此懦弱的国家，以至于它在没有宣战的情况下便侵入委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的卧室，绑架了他和妻子西莉亚·阿德莱·弗洛雷斯。如今，美国在不让二人获释的情况下将他们关押在境内拘留设施中，却无法就所谓贩毒罪名提出指控。美国所做的一切不过是打影子拳、非法拘禁这对夫妇、阻止委内瑞拉举行选举，以及窃取该国的石油和天然气。美国选民也厌倦了本国在全球遭到孤立，就连特朗普曾以战争相威胁、企图夺取丹麦殖民地格陵兰的传统欧洲盟友，也与其保持距离。总体而言，特朗普让这个世界变得远不如过去安全，美国选民对此心知肚明，并希望从MAGA阵营手中夺回自己的国家。他们通过投票表达了这一意愿。讽刺的是，许多共和党人未必会为事态的这一变化感到不满，因为他们也想从这个躁动不安的MAGA人群手中夺回自己的政党，或夺回政党仅剩的部分。另一个影响共和党的因素，是候选人的选择或强行指定。例如，共和党让得克萨斯州前总检察长肯·沃伦·帕克斯顿担任该州的联邦参议员候选人。问题在于，帕克斯顿曾于2015年7月28日被大陪审团以三项刑事罪名起诉。其中两项是证券欺诈（一级重罪），第三项是未向州证券监管机构登记。这位63岁候选人与37岁的民主党候选人詹姆斯·戴尔·塔拉里科形成了鲜明对比；后者曾是一名高中英语教师，主张增加学校经费。塔拉里科获得5,445,121票，占55.1%；帕克斯顿获得4,249,752票，占43%。另一个案例是迈克尔·沃特利，据说他是特朗普的坚定支持者。他在北卡罗来纳州竞选参议员，获得1,643,088票，而民主党候选人罗伊·库珀以2,467,963票胜出。不过，特朗普效应并非在所有方面都是负面。选民对他的反应或许也产生了一些积极结果。例如，它促成了基沙·兰斯·博特姆斯成为美国250年历史上首位黑人女性州长，也促成了新墨西哥州民主党人黛布·哈兰成为美国历史上首位美国原住民女性州长。它还促成了首位穆斯林参议员、首位女性原住民参议员和国会首位Z世代女性。对我们尼日利亚人而言，有4名尼日利亚裔美国人分别在马里兰州、华盛顿州、得克萨斯州和宾夕法尼亚州赢得选举。世界对美国这些变化的反应一如预期，呈现多种姿态。伊朗最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊预计美国对伊朗的政策不会发生任何根本性转变。因此，他宣称：“那些仍然怀有一丝希望，以为霸权体系的行为可能因党派或派系变动而改变，或者以为向美国作出让步便能阻止其对伊朗民族抱持敌意的人，都大错特错了。”欧盟方面则希望俄乌战争继续并延长。其副主席卡娅·卡拉斯说，她希望新一届国会继续支持乌克兰。这与特朗普为结束无谓流血而作出的有益努力形成鲜明对比。总体而言，美国中期选举的结果对人类而言是一桩好事。我们期待着一个更安全、更理智的世界，也期待特朗普安全地离开白宫。奥韦·拉肯法是非洲劳工组织前秘书长、人权活动家、记者和作家。

https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.summary: Amid unprecedented disruptions to global energy markets since the outbreak of the Iran war at the end of February, stronger policy support and intensified energy security concerns are driving faster deployment of renewable power across India, Southeast Asia, Africa and the Middle East. For the first time, the amount of renewable power capacity added in emerging and developing economies outside China is expected to match the amount added in advanced economies in the forecast period.
https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.summary_zh: 自2月底伊朗战争爆发以来，全球能源市场遭受前所未有的冲击。更有力的政策支持和不断加剧的能源安全担忧，正推动印度、东南亚、非洲和中东加快部署可再生能源发电。预测期内，中国以外新兴和发展中经济体新增的可再生能源发电装机容量预计将首次达到发达经济体新增装机容量的水平。
https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.body: No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result by Chika Izuora 7 seconds ago in Business The International Energy Agency (IEA) has provided fresh insight into global renewable energy developments , showing renewable capacity increase in emerging and developing economies outside China matching that in advanced economies for the first time as Hormuz crisis sharpens focus on domestic energy sources Renewables, already expanding at a record pace before the current energy crisis, are set to see strong growth across a wider range of countries around the world in the coming years as governments seek to strengthen energy security and reduce their exposure to imported fuels and volatile prices, according to the IEA’a latest report. Renewables 2026, this year’s edition of the IEA’s annual report on the sector, sees global renewable power capacity increasing by almost 4 800 gigawatts (GW) in the 2026-2031 period, almost 60% more than was added in the previous six-year period. Solar PV is set to account for more than three-quarters of global renewable capacity growth to 2031, followed by onshore wind. Amid unprecedented disruptions to global energy markets since the outbreak of the Iran war at the end of February, stronger policy support and intensified energy security concerns are driving faster deployment of renewable power across India, Southeast Asia, Africa and the Middle East. For the first time, the amount of renewable power capacity added in emerging and developing economies outside China is expected to match the amount added in advanced economies in the forecast period. China will remain the largest contributor to the global increase in renewable power capacity, but its share is set to decline from over 60% in 2025 to an average of 53% over the forecast period amid changes to its renewable energy policies. India is emerging as the world’s second-largest growth market, with its total renewable capacity set to more than double by 2031. Growth is also increasing across Southeast Asia, the Middle East and North Africa, and sub-Saharan Africa. Across these regions, the amount of renewable capacity added in the 2026-2031 period is forecast to almost triple compared with the previous six-year period. “Previously, environmental concerns were the policy priority behind the growth of renewables, whose falling costs have made them a competitive option in many markets – but today, it’s mainly energy security that is driving renewables’ expansion as more and more countries seek to reduce their exposure to imported fuels,” said IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol. “The new chapter of the renewables growth story is a truly global one as their deployment spreads well beyond major markets into every corner of the world. This is making them a key pillar of the global power sector. Today, they account for a third of global electricity generation; in the next five years, they will be getting closer to half of it.” The growth in renewable power additions is not only the result of major installations by utilities and developers; it is also being driven directly by consumers in many countries. Faced with high fuel prices and unreliable electricity supplies in some markets, households and small businesses around the world are increasingly turning to more affordable rooftop solar PV systems that can be installed quickly. These small-scale installations have already helped improve electricity services for around 70 million households worldwide, the report finds. The report forecasts that the use of renewable energy for transport will rise by more than 60 per cent by 2031, by which point it will cover 6 per cent of the transport sector’s energy demand worldwide. Renewable electricity used by electric vehicles accounts for around 45 per cent of this increase, while biofuels are making the second-largest contribution. As an immediate response to high fuel prices and availability challenges, several countries, notably in Southeast Asia and Latin America, have raised blending mandates, which set the minimum proportion of biofuels that has to be blended into gasoline or diesel sold at the pump. Our forecast for biofuels is revised up by 40% compared with last year’s report. The report also highlights the importance of secure and diversified supply chains as renewables take on a larger role in energy systems worldwide. India is emerging as an important alternative source of supply, with its share of global solar PV module manufacturing expected to almost double to 17 per cent over the next five years, helping diversify a market that remains highly concentrated. As solar PV and wind continue to expand rapidly around the world, enhancing power system flexibility becomes critically important for energy security, offering new opportunities in the process. The highest priority is for countries to ensure investment in electricity grids keeps pace with the growth of renewable capacity. This should be complemented by reforms to speed up the connection of new renewable power installations to electricity networks. The amount of advanced-stage renewable energy and storage projects waiting for grid connections worldwide increased by 60 per cent over the past year to 3 000 GW, four times the wind and solar PV capacity connected to the grid last year. Meanwhile, the deployment of battery storage has been accelerating in many countries, offering an important way to increase the flexibility of electricity systems rapidly. Measures to enable electricity demand to become more flexible are equally important and can be implemented quickly. Digital technologies, including artificial intelligence, can help shift demand towards periods when renewable power supply is abundant, allowing a better use of variable renewable generation sources. Together, these measures will be crucial to ensuring that the rapid expansion of renewables translates into more secure, affordable and reliable energy supplies worldwide We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.title_zh: 国际能源署：新兴经济体成为可再生能源投资最大地区，中国除外
https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.body_zh: 没有结果 查看全部结果 首页 新闻 政治 商业 体育 足球 健康 娱乐 教育 观点 社论 专栏 其他 LeVogue 杂志 会议 国家经济 联系我们 豪萨语版 首页 新闻 政治 商业 体育 足球 健康 娱乐 教育 观点 社论 专栏 其他 LeVogue 杂志 会议 国家经济 联系我们 没有结果 查看全部结果 没有结果 查看全部结果 Chika Izuora 7秒前 商业 国际能源署（IEA）就全球可再生能源的最新发展提供了新见解。数据显示，在霍尔木兹危机加剧各国对本土能源关注之际，中国以外新兴和发展中经济体的可再生能源装机增量首次预计将赶上发达经济体。IEA最新报告《可再生能源2026》是其关于该行业的年度旗舰报告。报告指出，可再生能源在当前能源危机爆发前已以创纪录速度扩张。随着各国政府寻求加强能源安全、减少对进口燃料和价格波动的依赖，未来几年可再生能源将在全球更多国家实现强劲增长。报告预计，2026年至2031年间，全球可再生能源发电装机容量将增加近4 800吉瓦（GW），比此前六年的增量高出近60%。到2031年，太阳能光伏将贡献全球可再生能源装机增量的四分之三以上，其次是陆上风电。自2月底伊朗战争爆发以来，全球能源市场遭遇空前中断。在更强政策支持和日益加剧的能源安全担忧推动下，印度、东南亚、非洲和中东正在更快部署可再生能源发电。预测期内，中国以外新兴和发展中经济体新增的可再生能源发电装机容量将首次预计与发达经济体新增装机量相当。随着其可再生能源政策发生变化，中国仍将是全球可再生能源发电装机增量最大的贡献国，但其占比预计将从2025年的60%以上降至预测期内的平均53%。印度正成为全球第二大可再生能源增长市场，到2031年其可再生能源总装机容量预计将增至两倍以上。东南亚、中东和北非以及撒哈拉以南非洲的装机增长也正在加快。报告预测，这些地区2026年至2031年间新增的可再生能源装机容量将接近此前六年的三倍。IEA执行主任Fatih Birol表示：“过去，环境担忧是推动可再生能源增长的政策优先事项，而不断下降的成本已使其在许多市场成为具有竞争力的选择。但如今，推动可再生能源扩张的主要因素是能源安全，越来越多国家希望减少对进口燃料的依赖。可再生能源增长故事正在开启真正全球化的新篇章，其应用正从主要市场延伸到世界每个角落。这正使可再生能源成为全球电力行业的支柱。如今，可再生能源占全球发电量的三分之一；未来五年，其占比将接近一半。”可再生能源发电新增装机的增长不仅来自公用事业公司和开发商的大型项目，也直接受到许多国家消费者的推动。面对一些市场燃料价格高企和供电不稳定的情况，全球家庭和小型企业正越来越多地转向价格更实惠、能够快速安装的屋顶太阳能光伏系统。报告发现，这些小规模安装项目已帮助全球约7 000万户家庭改善了电力服务。报告预测，到2031年，交通领域可再生能源使用量将增长60%以上，届时将满足全球交通行业能源需求的6%。电动车使用的可再生电力约贡献这一增量的45%，生物燃料则是第二大贡献来源。为应对燃料价格高企和供应方面的挑战，多个国家，尤其是东南亚和拉丁美洲国家，提高了强制掺混比例要求，规定加油站销售的汽油或柴油中必须掺入的生物燃料最低比例。我们对生物燃料的预测较去年的报告上调了40%。报告还强调，随着可再生能源在全球能源系统中承担更大角色，安全且多元化的供应链至关重要。印度正成为重要的替代供应来源，未来五年其在全球太阳能光伏组件制造中的份额预计将接近翻倍，达到17%，有助于推动这个仍高度集中的市场实现多元化。随着太阳能光伏和风电在全球各地继续快速扩张，提高电力系统灵活性对能源安全变得至关重要，同时也带来了新的机遇。各国当前的首要任务是确保电网投资跟上可再生能源装机容量的增长。还应通过改革，加快新可再生能源发电项目接入电网。全球等待并网的后期可再生能源及储能项目规模过去一年增长了60%，达到3 000吉瓦（GW），是去年并网风电和太阳能光伏装机的四倍。与此同时，许多国家正加速部署电池储能，为快速提高电力系统灵活性提供重要途径。使电力需求变得更灵活的举措同样重要，而且可以迅速实施。包括人工智能在内的数字技术可以将用电需求转移到可再生能源供应充足的时段，从而更充分地利用出力可变的可再生能源。这些措施将共同确保可再生能源的快速扩张转化为全球更安全、更实惠且更可靠的能源供应。我们掌握独家优势。立即将实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取24/7更新 →

MANILA, Philippines – A United States envoy dismissed reports on Saturday, November 7, that a framework agreement for the US-backed Pax Silica Economic Security Zone would be signed during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in Manila this month. “No such announcement on the Pax Silica Economic Security Zone was ever planned. Decisions will be made in full consultation with the government of the Philippines at the appropriate time,” US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton said in a statement. US President Donald Trump will be among the global leaders expected to attend the regional event. Envisioned as a massive 1,620-hectare industrial hub in New Clark City, Capas, Tarlac, the Pax Silica development is estimated by the BCDA to attract up to US$70 billion in investments and create as many as 190,000 direct jobs. The project, however, faces mounting criticisms in the Philippines, with many noting that the hub could harm the country’s environment, displace indigenous communities, and strain the Luzon energy grid because of its massive power and water needs, among others. “We look forward to working alongside the government of the Philippines about this exciting initiative to secure supply chains and attract quality investment in support of economic growth and jobs at home for the people,” Lipton said. – Rappler.com Upgrade to Rappler+ for exclusive content and unlimited access

https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.title: Why Beijing wants us to go quiet
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.summary: Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea. And now there are voices here saying perhaps we should oblige, perhaps transparency has done its job, perhaps it is time to be quiet for the sake of good relations. Before we go down that road, we should ask a simple question: Why does China want us quiet, and who benefits if we are?
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.summary_zh: 北京刚刚要求我国政府压制自己的民众，尤其是那些向公众展示西菲律宾海发生了什么的人。如今，国内又有人声称，也许我们应当照办，也许透明度已经完成了自己的使命，也许为了保持良好关系，是时候保持沉默。在我们走上这条道路之前，应当提出一个简单的问题：中国为什么希望我们保持沉默？如果我们保持沉默，谁将从中受益？
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.body: That sounds good. Nobody in the Philippine government is against keeping an open line of communication with China. But I read the other side’s version, too, and I suggest every Filipino do the same. In Xinhua’s account, Wang told Lazaro that relations are suffering from malicious interference by a small number of Filipino politicians who keep attacking China and crossing its red lines. He asked Manila to tighten its oversight of the individuals concerned and speak with one rational, unified voice on China. So let us not pretend this was only about lowering the temperature. Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea. And now there are voices here saying perhaps we should oblige, perhaps transparency has done its job, perhaps it is time to be quiet for the sake of good relations. Before we go down that road, we should ask a simple question: Why does China want us quiet, and who benefits if we are? I have been part of this since the beginning, so let me explain what transparency actually did. Before 2023, what happened at sea stayed at sea. The China Coast Guard would block us, ram us and hit us with water cannons, and the public would find out, if at all, through a diplomatic note filed weeks later. Beijing’s denial would come out the same afternoon. We began releasing videos, photographs, the exact time and location of each incident, and the legal basis for Philippine presence and jurisdiction, usually within hours. The water cannon attacks at Bajo de Masinloc. The military-grade laser pointed at our crew. The ramming of resupply boats at Ayungin. The swarming of vessels in our exclusive economic zone. All of it is now on the record, documented not only by Filipinos who were there with us but also by independent foreign journalists who witnessed these incidents firsthand. Yes, we deliberately leveraged one of our most cherished democratic values — freedom of the press — to help us tell the world the truth. China can still deny what happened, but it must now contend with photographic and video evidence. In the past, Beijing could more easily control the narrative, using malign influence operations to shape domestic and international public opinion. Our transparency initiative has fundamentally changed that dynamic, severely constraining China’s ability to manipulate information and distort the facts. Anyone working in defense or foreign policy who fails to understand these dynamics and their implications for long-term Philippine interests is neglecting a fundamental responsibility. Here is the first thing China gains if we go quiet: The world goes quiet with us. When Washington, Tokyo, Canberra, Ottawa, Brussels or the G7 condemn the actions of the China Coast Guard in our waters, they are not reacting to our news conferences. They are reacting to the footage we release. A foreign minister can issue a statement of concern based on compelling video evidence. No government issues such a statement based on rumors, much less on a confidential note verbale or diplomatic démarche delivered weeks after the incident. The same footage helps sustain the security partnerships we have built. Every like-minded government has to explain to its own parliament and people why it signs a maritime cooperation agreement with Manila, why its coast guard sails with ours and why it helps support our modernization. The daily record of Chinese behavior in the West Philippine Sea is their justification. Take it away, and supporting the Philippines becomes an abstraction. Abstractions do not survive a budget hearing. Beijing knows this. I am not sure all of our own officials do. When dealing with an actor that has lied many times and fooled us on numerous occasions, silence does not buy us greater diplomatic space. It simply takes us back to how things were before 2023, when China kept pushing the envelope and we filed diplomatic protests whose full contents nobody ever saw. China has learned from our last two elections that being seen as close to Beijing is now a liability in Philippine politics. Candidates who once proudly boasted of their friendship with China now prefer to change the subject. It is difficult to campaign on the claim that China is our friend when voters can see, on their own phones, Chinese Coast Guard vessels firing water cannons at Philippine Coast Guard ships, threatening Filipino fishermen and depriving them of their livelihoods. Beijing’s answer to that problem is not to change how it behaves at sea. It is to make sure nobody sees it anymore. If transparency ends in 2027, the West Philippine Sea is out of the news by 2028. People forget. The field is then wide open for politicians who owe Beijing, backed by Beijing’s money, to take back Malacañang and put the next president on a leash for six years. It is about who sits in the Palace after 2028 and whether that person answers to the Filipino people or to someone else. One last detail from this week, because it tells you everything about who we are dealing with. Our DFA says Secretary Lazaro received the call from Wang. Xinhua says Wang took the call at Lazaro’s request. China’s malign influence operators got to work and reinforced this messaging to make the Philippines appear desperate. The Chinese term they used, 应约, is the formula Beijing uses when the other side asked for the conversation. In other words, the two governments cannot agree on who picked up the phone first. In December 2023, Beijing said then-Secretary Manalo had requested his call with Wang. Diplomatic sources in Manila insisted it was the Chinese side that called. Twice now, on the most trivial of things in diplomacy, China has told the world a different story from the one it told us. Both times, the story made the Philippines look like the one coming to Beijing, hat in hand, to patch things up. And this latest one came barely two weeks after their ambassador reminded us that China could easily win if it chose to use force. And now Beijing is asking us to trust its good faith and stop documenting what its ships do in our own waters. If China is willing to rewrite the record of a phone call, what would stop it from doing the same with a water cannon attack, a ramming incident or the next confrontation at Bajo de Masinloc or Ayungin? Without footage from our side, Beijing would be free to push its version of events, with little evidence available to challenge it. Diplomacy with China remains necessary, but it must never come at the expense of documenting what happens in our waters. Footage provides evidence that Beijing cannot simply dismiss or explain away. A country that cannot be honest about who dialed cannot be trusted to be honest about anything that matters more. Your subscription could not be saved. Please try again. Your subscription has been successful.
